source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In year three of [the] reign of Belshazzar the king, a vision appeared to me, I, Daniel, after the [one] that appeared to me at the beginning.

en.L: In the third year of the reign of Belshazzar the king, a vision appeared to me, Daniel, after the one that had appeared to me at the first.
en.B: In the third year of King Belshazzar's reign, I, Daniel, had a vision, after the one I had seen earlier.
en.R: In King Belshazzar's third year as king, I, Daniel, saw another vision. It came after the vision I had seen before.

fr.L: La troisième année du règne de Belshatsar, le roi, une vision m’apparut, à moi, Daniel, après celle qui m’était apparue au commencement.
fr.B: La troisième année du règne du roi Belshatsar, moi, Daniel, j’eus une vision, après celle que j’avais vue auparavant.
fr.R: Le roi Belshatsar régnait depuis trois ans quand moi, Daniel, j’ai vu une autre vision. Elle est venue après la vision que j’avais vue avant.

es.L: En el año tercero del reinado de Belsasar el rey, se me apareció una visión a mí, Daniel, después de la que se me había aparecido al principio.
es.B: En el tercer año del reinado del rey Belsasar, yo, Daniel, tuve una visión, después de la que había tenido antes.
es.R: Cuando el rey Belsasar llevaba tres años como rey, yo, Daniel, tuve otra visión. La tuve después de la visión que ya había visto antes.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wa Belshaza mfalme, maono yalinitokea mimi, Danieli, baada ya yale yaliyonitokea hapo kwanza.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wa Mfalme Belshaza, mimi Danieli niliona maono, baada ya yale niliyokuwa nimeyaona mwanzoni.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa Belshaza kuwa mfalme, mimi Danieli niliona maono mengine. Yalikuja baada ya maono niliyokuwa nimeyaona kabla.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ ba triều đại của vua Bên-xát-sa, một khải tượng đã hiện ra cho tôi, là Đa-ni-ên, sau [khải tượng] đã hiện ra cho tôi lúc trước.
vi.B: Vào năm thứ ba triều vua Bên-xát-sa, tôi, Đa-ni-ên, thấy một khải tượng, sau khải tượng tôi đã thấy lần trước.
vi.R: Vào năm thứ ba vua Bên-xát-sa trị vì, tôi, Đa-ni-ên, lại thấy một khải tượng khác. Khải tượng này đến sau khải tượng tôi đã thấy trước kia.

ko.L: 벨사살 왕의 통치 제3년에, 처음에 나에게 나타났던 [환상] 뒤에, 한 환상이 나, 곧 다니엘에게 나타났다.
ko.B: 벨사살 왕이 다스린 지 3년째 되는 해에, 나 다니엘은 전에 본 환상에 이어 또 한 환상을 보았다.
ko.R: 벨사살이 왕이 된 지 3년째 되는 해에, 나 다니엘은 또 다른 환상을 보았다. 그것은 내가 전에 본 환상 다음에 본 것이었다.

decisions.choice: the book returns to Hebrew
decisions.reason: From 2:4 to 7:28 the book is written in Aramaic. With this verse it goes back to Hebrew, the language of 1:1-2:4, and stays in Hebrew to the end. The visions of chapters 8-12 concern the people of Israel and their sanctuary more closely than the Aramaic chapters, which speak to the nations; some readers see that as the reason for the change, but the book does not give one.

decisions.choice: the third year of Belshazzar: about two years after the vision of chapter 7
decisions.reason: Chapter 7 is dated to Belshazzar's first year (7:1). This vision came two years later, still before the fall of Babylon in 539 BC (chapter 5).

decisions.choice: the one that appeared to me at the first: the vision of chapter 7
decisions.reason: This vision takes up the picture of chapter 7 again, with new beasts: a ram and a goat, and a small horn that grows great (8:9; compare 7:8).

decisions.choice: in the third year of King Belshazzar's reign (B); in King Belshazzar's third year as king (R)
decisions.reason: The date follows the wording set for dated headings in Jeremiah. Readable adds "another" vision, since one came before it.

decisions.choice: Daniel's first-person narrative (chapters 8-12) in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("une vision m'apparut", "je vis") and the passé composé at Readable ("j'ai vu"); speech keeps the tenses of speech
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for these books sets for first-person narrative (Ezekiel's visions, Daniel 7-12): the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé that of plain modern French. Gabriel's and the angel's long speeches are speech, in the present, future and passé composé.

decisions.choice: "La troisième année du règne du roi Belshatsar" (B); "Le roi Belshatsar régnait depuis trois ans quand ..." (R)
decisions.reason: French dates a reign with "la ... année du règne de"; Readable turns the date into a plain clause, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wa Belshaza" (L, B); "mwaka wa tatu wa Belshaza kuwa mfalme" (R)
decisions.reason: The year formula of the prophets' headings in the Swahili term sheet: "utawala wa X" at Balanced and "X kuwa mfalme" at Readable. "Maono" is the word for vision throughout Daniel.

decisions.choice: "khải tượng" for the vision (chazon) at every level
decisions.reason: The word used for prophetic visions in the published Vietnamese of Ezekiel (1:1) and Isaiah; it is kept for every vision in Daniel 8-12. "Thị kiến" is the Catholic word.

decisions.choice: From 8:1 Daniel narrates in the first person ("나 다니엘") in the plain written style in 했다; God takes -시- and 께서 at every level, while angels, kings and beasts do not
decisions.reason: The book returns to Hebrew here, but the Korean does not mark the change of language in the wording; the speech levels set for Daniel hold through chapters 8-12: angels speak to Daniel in 해라체, Daniel answers them and prays in 합쇼체.

decisions.choice: "통치 제3년에" (L); "다스린 지 3년째 되는 해에" (B); "왕이 된 지 3년째 되는 해에" (R)
decisions.reason: The dated heading follows the Kings formula used at 1:1, with the year in figures.

decisions.choice: "el año tercero" (L); "el tercer año" (B); "llevaba tres años como rey" (R)
decisions.reason: Worded as the dating of 1:1 in Spanish, so the two headings read alike

source.text: וָֽאֶרְאֶה֮ בֶּחָזוֹן֒ וַיְהִי֙ בִּרְאֹתִ֔י וַאֲנִי֙ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵילָ֣ם הַמְּדִינָ֑ה וָאֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽחָז֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל־אוּבַ֥ל אוּלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I saw in the vision, and it was when I saw, and I [was] in Susa the citadel, which [is] in Elam the province, and I saw in the vision, and I was by the canal of Ulai.

en.L: And I saw in the vision, and when I saw, I was in Susa the citadel, in the province of Elam; and I saw in the vision: I was at the Ulai canal.
en.B: In the vision I saw myself in the fortress city of Susa, in the province of Elam. In the vision I was beside the Ulai Canal.
en.R: In the vision I saw that I was in the walled city of Susa, in the province of Elam. I was standing beside the Ulai Canal.

fr.L: Et je vis dans la vision, et il arriva, quand je vis, [que] j’[étais] à Suse, la citadelle, qui [est] dans la province d’Élam ; et je vis dans la vision, et j’étais près du canal de l’Oulaï.
fr.B: Dans la vision, je me vis à Suse, la ville fortifiée, dans la province d’Élam. Dans la vision, j’étais au bord du canal d’Oulaï.
fr.R: Dans la vision, j’ai vu que j’étais dans la ville fortifiée de Suse, dans la province d’Élam. Je me tenais au bord du canal d’Oulaï.

es.L: Y miré en la visión, y sucedió que, al mirar, yo estaba en Susa, la ciudadela, que [está] en la provincia de Elam; y miré en la visión, y yo estaba junto al río Ulai.
es.B: En la visión me vi en la fortaleza de Susa, en la provincia de Elam. En la visión yo estaba junto al canal Ulai.
es.R: En la visión vi que estaba en la ciudad amurallada de Susa, en la provincia de Elam. Estaba de pie junto al canal Ulai.

sw.L: Nami nikaona katika maono; na ikawa nilipoona, nilikuwa katika Shushani ngomeni, ulioko katika jimbo la Elamu; nami nikaona katika maono, nami nilikuwa kando ya mto Ulai.
sw.B: Katika maono nilijiona nikiwa katika mji wa ngome wa Shushani, katika jimbo la Elamu. Katika maono hayo nilikuwa kando ya mto Ulai.
sw.R: Katika maono hayo niliona kwamba nilikuwa katika mji wenye kuta wa Shushani, katika jimbo la Elamu. Nilikuwa nimesimama kando ya mfereji wa Ulai.

vi.L: Và tôi đã nhìn trong khải tượng, và khi tôi nhìn thì tôi ở tại Su-sa, thành lũy, trong tỉnh Ê-lam; và tôi đã nhìn trong khải tượng, và tôi ở bên sông U-lai.
vi.B: Trong khải tượng, tôi thấy mình đang ở trong thành lũy Su-sa, thuộc tỉnh Ê-lam. Trong khải tượng, tôi đang ở bên kênh U-lai.
vi.R: Trong khải tượng, tôi thấy mình đang ở trong thành Su-sa có tường lũy kiên cố, thuộc tỉnh Ê-lam. Tôi đang đứng bên kênh U-lai.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 환상 속에서 보았는데, 내가 볼 때에 나는 엘람 지방에 있는 수산 성에 있었다. 그리고 내가 환상 속에서 보니, 나는 을래 강 가에 있었다.
ko.B: 환상 속에서 나는 엘람 지방에 있는 요새 도시 수산 성에 있었다. 환상 속에서 나는 을래 운하 가에 있었다.
ko.R: 환상 속에서 나는 엘람 지방에 있는, 성벽으로 둘러싸인 수산 성에 있었다. 나는 을래 운하 가에 서 있었다.

decisions.choice: I was in Susa: Daniel was there in the vision, not in body
decisions.reason: The verse twice says "in the vision". Daniel is taken in the vision to Susa, as Ezekiel was taken in visions to Jerusalem (Ezekiel 8:3; 40:1-2). It does not say that he travelled there.

decisions.choice: Susa the citadel, in the province of Elam
decisions.reason: Susa lay east of Babylon, in the land of Elam (south-west Iran). Under the Persian kings it became one of the royal capitals, where the stories of Esther and of Nehemiah take place (Esther 1:2; Nehemiah 1:1). The word for "citadel" is the one used there for the fortified palace city.

decisions.choice: the Ulai canal: a waterway near Susa
decisions.reason: The Ulai is known from Assyrian and Greek records as a river or canal by Susa. The rare word may mean a canal, or, as some ancient translations took it, a gate. The sense "canal" or "stream" fits verses 3 and 6.

decisions.choice: the fortress city of Susa (B); the walled city of Susa (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the citadel" means here and leave out the repeated "I saw in the vision" where the sentence already says it once.

decisions.choice: "Suse, la citadelle" (L), "Suse, la ville fortifiée" (B), "la ville fortifiée de Suse" (R); "le canal de l'Oulaï" (L), "le canal d'Oulaï" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Names as the term sheet gives them: "Suse" as published Ezra 4:9; the Ulai is a canal or waterway, not a river, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "Shushani" for Susa; "mto Ulai" (L, B), "mfereji wa Ulai" (R)
decisions.reason: "Shushani" is the published form in Ezra 4:9. The term sheet gives "mto Ulai" at Literal and Balanced, as the published "mto" for Ahava and Kebar, and "mfereji" (canal) at Readable, where the English "canal" is spelled out.

decisions.choice: "sông U-lai" (L); "kênh U-lai" (B, R); "Su-sa"
decisions.reason: As the book's term sheet sets it: Literal says "sông" for the waterway, Balanced and Readable "kênh", as the English "Ulai Canal". Susa is "Su-sa" and Elam the published "Ê-lam".

decisions.choice: "수산 성", "엘람 지방"; "을래 강" (L) and "을래 운하" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Susa is spelled as in Ezra 4:9; the Ulai is a waterway, and Balanced and Readable say "운하" as the English says "canal", as Ezekiel's Kebar is "그발 운하".

decisions.choice: "el río Ulai" (L); "el canal Ulai" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the Ulai in chapter 8, as for the Kebar in Ezekiel: L keeps the traditional "río", B and R say "canal", the likely sense of the word. "Susa" and "Elam" are the published forms

source.text: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֗ד עֹמֵ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֻבָ֖ל וְל֣וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם וְהַקְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְהָאַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן־הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית וְהַ֨גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, a ram, one, standing before the canal, and to it two horns, and the two horns [were] high, and the one [was] higher than the second, and the higher [one] coming up last.

en.L: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, a ram standing before the canal, and it had two horns. Both horns were high, but one was higher than the second, and the higher one came up last.
en.B: I looked up and saw a ram standing beside the canal. It had two long horns, one of them longer than the other, and it was the longer one that grew up last.
en.R: I looked up and saw a ram standing beside the canal. It had two long horns. One horn was longer than the other, and the longer one had grown up later.

fr.L: Et je levai les yeux et je vis, et voici, un bélier, un [seul], se tenait devant le canal, et il [avait] deux cornes ; et les deux cornes [étaient] hautes, et l’une [était] plus haute que la seconde, et la plus haute s’éleva la dernière.
fr.B: Je levai les yeux et je vis un bélier qui se tenait au bord du canal. Il avait deux longues cornes, l’une plus longue que l’autre, et c’était la plus longue qui avait poussé en dernier.
fr.R: J’ai levé les yeux et j’ai vu un bélier qui se tenait au bord du canal. Il avait deux longues cornes. L’une était plus longue que l’autre, et c’était la plus longue qui avait poussé après l’autre.

es.L: Y alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí un carnero que estaba de pie delante del río, y tenía dos cuernos; y los dos cuernos [eran] altos, pero uno era más alto que el otro, y el más alto subió el último.
es.B: Levanté la vista y vi un carnero que estaba de pie junto al canal. Tenía dos cuernos largos, uno más largo que el otro, y el más largo había crecido después.
es.R: Miré y vi un carnero que estaba de pie junto al canal. Tenía dos cuernos largos. Uno era más largo que el otro, y el más largo le había salido después.

sw.L: Nami nikainua macho yangu, nikaona, na tazama, kondoo dume mmoja amesimama mbele ya mto, naye alikuwa na pembe mbili; na pembe hizo mbili zilikuwa ndefu, na moja ilikuwa ndefu kuliko ya pili, na ile ndefu zaidi ilitokea mwisho.
sw.B: Nikainua macho, nikaona kondoo dume amesimama kando ya mto. Alikuwa na pembe mbili ndefu; moja ilikuwa ndefu kuliko nyingine, na ile ndefu zaidi ndiyo iliyoota mwisho.
sw.R: Nilitazama juu, nikaona kondoo dume amesimama kando ya mfereji. Alikuwa na pembe mbili ndefu. Pembe moja ilikuwa ndefu kuliko nyingine, na ile ndefu zaidi ilikuwa imeota baadaye.

vi.L: Và tôi ngước mắt lên và nhìn, và kìa, một con chiên đực đứng trước sông, và nó có hai sừng; và hai sừng ấy [đều] cao, và một [sừng] cao hơn sừng kia, và cái cao hơn mọc lên sau cùng.
vi.B: Tôi ngước mắt nhìn lên và thấy một con chiên đực đứng bên kênh. Nó có hai sừng dài, một sừng dài hơn sừng kia, và sừng dài hơn lại mọc lên sau.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn lên và thấy một con chiên đực đứng bên kênh. Nó có hai cái sừng dài. Một sừng dài hơn sừng kia, và cái sừng dài hơn ấy mọc lên sau.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 눈을 들어 보니, 보라, 숫양 한 마리가 강 앞에 서 있는데, 그것에게 두 뿔이 있었다. 그리고 그 두 뿔은 높았는데, 하나가 다른 하나보다 더 높았고, 더 높은 것이 나중에 올라왔다.
ko.B: 내가 눈을 들어 보니, 숫양 한 마리가 운하 가에 서 있었다. 그 숫양에게는 긴 뿔이 두 개 있었는데, 하나가 다른 하나보다 더 길었고, 더 긴 뿔이 나중에 자라났다.
ko.R: 내가 고개를 들어 보니, 숫양 한 마리가 운하 가에 서 있었다. 그 숫양에게는 긴 뿔이 두 개 있었다. 한 뿔이 다른 뿔보다 더 길었는데, 더 긴 뿔이 나중에 자라난 것이었다.

decisions.choice: a ram with two horns: the kings of Media and Persia (verse 20)
decisions.reason: Here the vision is explained by name: the ram is the kings of Media and Persia (verse 20). The longer horn that came up last is Persia, which rose after the Medes but became the greater power under Cyrus.

decisions.choice: I lifted up my eyes and saw: I looked up and saw something new
decisions.reason: The phrase marks the start of a new scene in a vision (10:5; Zechariah 2:1; 5:1).

decisions.choice: long, longer (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means high or tall. Of horns, Balanced and Readable say "long". They say "looked up" for the idiom (m2), as in Zechariah.

decisions.choice: "le bélier" and (from verse 5) "le bouc" for the whole chapter; "corne(s)" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for Daniel 8, and as Revelation 13's horns: the vision's animals keep their plain names at every level.

decisions.choice: "kondoo dume" for the ram and "pembe" for horn
decisions.reason: "Kondoo dume" is the published word for a ram (2 Chronicles 29:21); "pembe" is the word for the beasts' horns in Revelation 13:1. "Ndefu" (long) renders "high" of horns at every level, the natural Swahili adjective for them.

decisions.choice: "con chiên đực" (ram); "sừng" (horn)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for the animals of Daniel's visions: "con chiên đực" as in the sacrificial laws, and "sừng" for every horn, including "cái sừng nhỏ" in verse 9. The animal stays an animal at every level; verses 20-22 give the meaning.

decisions.choice: "보라" for hinneh (L); dropped at B and R, where "갑자기" or the plain sentence carries it
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the vision's "look"; Balanced and Readable say it with the sentence itself, as the English does, through chapters 8-12.

decisions.choice: "alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí" (L); "Levanté la vista y vi" (B); "Miré y vi" (R)
decisions.reason: The vision formula used through Daniel 8–12: L keeps the Hebrew picture and "he aquí", B and R say it plainly

decisions.choice: "un carnero"; "cuernos"
decisions.reason: The animals of the vision keep one word each through the chapter: "carnero" for the ram, "macho cabrío" for the goat, "cuerno" for each horn

source.text: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־הָאַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּחַ֩ יָ֨מָּה וְצָפ֜וֹנָה וָנֶ֗גְבָּה וְכָל־חַיּוֹת֙ לֹֽא־יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִיָּד֑וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה כִרְצֹנ֖וֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: I saw the ram goring westward and northward and southward, and all beasts not stood before it, and there [was] none delivering from its hand, and it did according to its will, and it magnified itself.

en.L: I saw the ram charging westward and northward and southward, and no beasts could stand before it, and there was no one to rescue from its hand; and it did as it pleased, and became great.
en.B: I watched the ram butting toward the west, the north and the south. No animal could stand against it, and no one could rescue anything from its power. It did whatever it wanted and became great.
en.R: I watched the ram charging toward the west, the north and the south. No other animal could stand up to it. No one could save anyone from its power. It did whatever it wanted and became very powerful.

fr.L: Je vis le bélier donner des coups de cornes vers l’ouest, et vers le nord, et vers le sud, et aucune bête ne tenait devant lui, et il n’y avait personne pour délivrer de sa main ; et il faisait selon sa volonté, et il devint grand.
fr.B: Je vis le bélier donner des coups de cornes vers l’ouest, le nord et le sud. Aucun animal ne pouvait lui résister, et personne ne pouvait arracher quoi que ce soit à son pouvoir. Il faisait tout ce qu’il voulait et il devint grand.
fr.R: J’ai vu le bélier foncer vers l’ouest, le nord et le sud. Aucun autre animal ne pouvait lui tenir tête. Personne ne pouvait sauver qui que ce soit de son pouvoir. Il faisait tout ce qu’il voulait et il est devenu très puissant.

es.L: Vi al carnero que embestía hacia el occidente, hacia el norte y hacia el sur, y ninguna bestia podía estar en pie delante de él, y no había quien librara de su mano; y hacía conforme a su voluntad, y se engrandecía.
es.B: Vi al carnero dando cornadas hacia el oeste, el norte y el sur. Ninguna bestia podía hacerle frente, y nadie podía librar nada de su poder. Hacía lo que quería y llegó a ser grande.
es.R: Vi al carnero atacando hacia el oeste, el norte y el sur. Ningún otro animal podía enfrentarse a él. Nadie podía salvar a nadie de su poder. Hacía todo lo que quería y se volvió muy poderoso.

sw.L: Nilimwona yule kondoo dume akipiga kwa pembe kuelekea magharibi na kaskazini na kusini, na hakuna wanyama walioweza kusimama mbele yake, wala hapakuwa na mtu wa kuokoa kutoka mkononi mwake; naye alifanya kama alivyopenda, akajikuza.
sw.B: Nilimtazama yule kondoo dume akipiga kwa pembe zake kuelekea magharibi, kaskazini na kusini. Hakuna mnyama aliyeweza kusimama mbele yake, wala hakuna aliyeweza kuokoa chochote kutoka katika uwezo wake. Alifanya kila alichotaka, akawa mkuu.
sw.R: Nilimtazama yule kondoo dume akishambulia kuelekea magharibi, kaskazini na kusini. Hakuna mnyama mwingine aliyeweza kumpinga. Hakuna aliyeweza kumwokoa yeyote kutoka katika nguvu zake. Alifanya chochote alichotaka, akawa na nguvu nyingi sana.

vi.L: Tôi thấy con chiên đực húc về phía tây và phía bắc và phía nam, và không con thú nào đứng nổi trước nó, và không ai giải cứu khỏi tay nó; và nó làm theo ý mình và trở nên lớn mạnh.
vi.B: Tôi thấy con chiên đực húc về phía tây, phía bắc và phía nam. Không con thú nào chống cự nổi nó, và không ai giải cứu được khỏi quyền lực của nó. Nó muốn làm gì thì làm và trở nên lớn mạnh.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn con chiên đực lao tới húc về phía tây, phía bắc và phía nam. Không con vật nào chống lại được nó. Không ai cứu được ai khỏi quyền lực của nó. Nó muốn làm gì thì làm và trở nên rất hùng mạnh.

ko.L: 내가 보니, 그 숫양이 서쪽과 북쪽과 남쪽으로 들이받는데, 어떤 짐승도 그 앞에 설 수 없었고, 그 손에서 구해 낼 자가 없었다. 그리고 그것은 제 뜻대로 행하며 스스로 커졌다.
ko.B: 나는 그 숫양이 서쪽과 북쪽과 남쪽으로 들이받는 것을 보았다. 어떤 짐승도 그것을 당해 낼 수 없었고, 그 힘에서 무엇을 구해 낼 수 있는 이도 없었다. 그것은 제 마음대로 하며 강대해졌다.
ko.R: 나는 그 숫양이 서쪽과 북쪽과 남쪽으로 돌진하는 것을 보았다. 다른 어떤 짐승도 그것을 막아 낼 수 없었다. 아무도 그 힘에서 누구를 구해 낼 수 없었다. 그것은 하고 싶은 대로 다 하며 아주 강해졌다.

decisions.choice: west, north and south: the conquests of the Persian empire
decisions.reason: The Persian kings pushed west into Asia Minor, north toward the Caucasus and south into Egypt. The ram does not charge east, the direction from which it came.

decisions.choice: it did as it pleased and became great: it ruled without check
decisions.reason: The same words are used of the goat (verse 8), of the small horn (verses 9-11), and of the kings of chapter 11 (11:3, 16, 36). Each "does as it pleases" until God sets its end.

decisions.choice: butting (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is used of an animal goring with its horns. Literal and Readable say "charging"; Balanced "butting".

decisions.choice: "bestia" (L, B); "animal" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide words for the beasts of the visions: "bestias" at L and B, "animales" at R, as the English R says "animal"

source.text: וַאֲנִ֣י׀הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְהִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר־הָֽעִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן־הַֽמַּעֲרָב֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨צָּפִ֔יר קֶ֥רֶן חָז֖וּת בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And I was observing, and look, a he-goat of the goats coming from the west over the face of all the earth, and not touching the ground, and the he-goat, a horn of conspicuousness [was] between its eyes.

en.L: And as I was considering, look, a male goat was coming from the west across the face of the whole earth, without touching the ground; and the goat had a conspicuous horn between its eyes.
en.B: As I was thinking about this, a male goat suddenly came from the west, crossing the whole earth without touching the ground. The goat had a prominent horn between its eyes.
en.R: As I was thinking about this, suddenly a male goat came from the west. It moved across the whole earth so fast that its feet did not touch the ground. This goat had one large horn between its eyes.

fr.L: Et moi, j’étais attentif, et voici, un bouc venait de l’ouest sur la face de toute la terre, et il ne touchait pas le sol ; et le bouc [avait] une corne remarquable entre ses yeux.
fr.B: Comme je réfléchissais à cela, un bouc arriva soudain de l’ouest, parcourant toute la terre sans toucher le sol. Ce bouc avait une corne bien visible entre les yeux.
fr.R: Pendant que je réfléchissais à cela, un bouc est soudain arrivé de l’ouest. Il traversait toute la terre si vite que ses pattes ne touchaient pas le sol. Ce bouc avait une grande corne entre les yeux.

es.L: Y mientras yo consideraba [esto], he aquí que un macho cabrío venía del occidente sobre la faz de toda la tierra, sin tocar el suelo; y el macho cabrío tenía un cuerno notable entre sus ojos.
es.B: Mientras yo pensaba en esto, de repente un macho cabrío vino del oeste, cruzando toda la tierra sin tocar el suelo. El macho cabrío tenía un cuerno prominente entre los ojos.
es.R: Mientras pensaba en esto, de pronto llegó del oeste un macho cabrío. Atravesaba toda la tierra tan rápido que sus patas no tocaban el suelo. Este macho cabrío tenía un solo cuerno grande entre los ojos.

sw.L: Nami nilipokuwa nikitafakari, tazama, beberu alikuwa akija kutoka magharibi juu ya uso wa dunia yote, bila kuigusa ardhi; na yule beberu alikuwa na pembe iliyo dhahiri kati ya macho yake.
sw.B: Nilipokuwa nikitafakari jambo hilo, ghafla beberu alikuja kutoka magharibi, akivuka dunia yote bila kugusa ardhi. Beberu huyo alikuwa na pembe kubwa iliyoonekana wazi kati ya macho yake.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa nikifikiri juu ya jambo hilo, ghafla beberu alikuja kutoka magharibi. Alipita juu ya dunia yote kwa kasi sana hata miguu yake haikugusa ardhi. Beberu huyo alikuwa na pembe moja kubwa kati ya macho yake.

vi.L: Và tôi đang suy xét, thì kìa, một con dê đực từ phía tây đến trên khắp mặt đất, mà không chạm đất; và con dê đực có một cái sừng dễ thấy giữa hai mắt nó.
vi.B: Đang khi tôi suy nghĩ về điều ấy, thình lình một con dê đực từ phía tây đến, băng qua khắp mặt đất mà không chạm đất. Con dê có một cái sừng nổi bật giữa hai mắt.
vi.R: Trong khi tôi đang suy nghĩ về điều đó, thình lình một con dê đực từ phía tây đến. Nó chạy băng qua khắp mặt đất nhanh đến nỗi chân không chạm đất. Con dê này có một cái sừng lớn ở giữa hai mắt.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 깊이 생각하고 있을 때에, 보라, 숫염소 한 마리가 서쪽에서 와서 온 땅 위를 지나가는데, 땅에 닿지 않았다. 그리고 그 숫염소는 두 눈 사이에 눈에 띄는 뿔이 [하나] 있었다.
ko.B: 내가 이 일을 곰곰이 생각하고 있을 때에, 갑자기 숫염소 한 마리가 서쪽에서 나타나 땅에 발도 닿지 않은 채 온 땅을 가로질러 왔다. 그 숫염소의 두 눈 사이에는 두드러진 뿔이 하나 있었다.
ko.R: 내가 이 일을 생각하고 있을 때에, 갑자기 숫염소 한 마리가 서쪽에서 왔다. 그것은 온 땅을 가로질러 달려왔는데, 얼마나 빨랐던지 발이 땅에 닿지 않았다. 이 숫염소의 두 눈 사이에는 커다란 뿔이 하나 있었다.

decisions.choice: a goat from the west with one great horn: the king of Greece (verse 21)
decisions.reason: Verse 21 names the goat as the king of Greece and the great horn as its first king. The usual identification of the horn is Alexander the Great, who in 334-331 BC swept across the Persian empire with great speed. The text names the kingdom but not the king.

decisions.choice: without touching the ground: with great speed
decisions.reason: The goat runs so fast that it seems to fly over the earth. Compare the leopard with wings in 7:6.

decisions.choice: so fast that its feet did not touch the ground (R)
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the picture means (m2).

decisions.choice: "j'étais attentif" (L) for the participle "I was observing"
decisions.reason: A natural French imparfait for an ongoing act of attention; Balanced and Readable say what Daniel was doing, "je réfléchissais".

decisions.choice: "beberu" for the male goat
decisions.reason: "Beberu" is the published word for a male goat (2 Chronicles 29:21; Ezekiel 43:22) and keeps the goat distinct from the ram ("kondoo dume").

decisions.choice: "con dê đực" (he-goat)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word. Verse 21 adds "xồm lông" where the Hebrew calls it "the hairy one".

decisions.choice: "숫양" (ram) and "숫염소" (male goat) at every level
decisions.reason: The plain animal words the term sheet sets for Daniel's visions, so that the interpretation in verses 20-21 points back to them.

decisions.choice: "un macho cabrío"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish word for a he-goat, at every level; Hebrew "he-goat of the goats" needs no more than this

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֗א עַד־הָאַ֨יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֻבָ֑ל וַיָּ֥רָץ אֵלָ֖יו בַּחֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it came to the ram, the possessor of the two horns, which I had seen standing before the canal, and it ran at it in the fury of its strength.

en.L: And it came to the ram that had the two horns, which I had seen standing before the canal, and it ran at it in the fury of its strength.
en.B: It came up to the two-horned ram that I had seen standing beside the canal, and charged at it with furious strength.
en.R: It came toward the ram with the two horns, which I had seen standing beside the canal. It ran at the ram in a fierce rage.

fr.L: Et il vint jusqu’au bélier qui avait les deux cornes, que j’avais vu se tenir devant le canal, et il courut sur lui dans la fureur de sa force.
fr.B: Il s’approcha du bélier aux deux cornes, que j’avais vu se tenir au bord du canal, et fonça sur lui de toute sa force furieuse.
fr.R: Il s’est dirigé vers le bélier aux deux cornes, celui que j’avais vu au bord du canal. Il a foncé sur lui avec une rage terrible.

es.L: Y vino hasta el carnero que tenía los dos cuernos, el que yo había visto de pie delante del río, y corrió contra él con el furor de su fuerza.
es.B: Llegó hasta el carnero de dos cuernos que yo había visto de pie junto al canal y lo embistió con furiosa fuerza.
es.R: Se acercó al carnero de los dos cuernos, el que yo había visto de pie junto al canal. Corrió hacia el carnero con una furia terrible.

sw.L: Naye akamjia yule kondoo dume mwenye pembe mbili, niliyemwona amesimama mbele ya mto, akamkimbilia kwa ghadhabu ya nguvu zake.
sw.B: Alimjia yule kondoo dume mwenye pembe mbili niliyemwona amesimama kando ya mto, akamshambulia kwa nguvu zake zote na hasira kali.
sw.R: Alimwendea yule kondoo dume mwenye pembe mbili, ambaye nilikuwa nimemwona amesimama kando ya mfereji. Alimkimbilia kwa hasira kali sana.

vi.L: Và nó đến cùng con chiên đực có hai sừng, mà tôi đã thấy đứng trước sông, và nó lao vào con chiên trong cơn thịnh nộ của sức mạnh nó.
vi.B: Nó đến gần con chiên đực có hai sừng mà tôi đã thấy đứng bên kênh, rồi dùng hết sức lực lao vào con chiên trong cơn giận dữ.
vi.R: Nó tiến về phía con chiên đực có hai sừng mà tôi đã thấy đứng bên kênh. Nó giận dữ lao vào con chiên.

ko.L: 그리고 그것이 두 뿔의 주인인 그 숫양, 곧 내가 강 앞에 서 있는 것을 보았던 [숫양]에게까지 와서, 그 힘의 분노로 그것에게 달려갔다.
ko.B: 그것은 내가 운하 가에 서 있는 것을 보았던, 두 뿔 달린 숫양에게 다가와서 맹렬한 기세로 그것에게 달려들었다.
ko.R: 그것은 두 뿔 달린 숫양 쪽으로 다가왔다. 그 숫양은 내가 운하 가에 서 있는 것을 보았던 바로 그 숫양이었다. 숫염소는 몹시 성이 나서 숫양에게 달려들었다.

decisions.choice: in the fury of its strength: with all its force, in fierce rage
decisions.reason: The words for heat and strength are joined: the goat attacks with the full force of its anger.

decisions.choice: the two-horned ram (B); the ram with the two horns (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls it "the owner of the two horns", a way of saying it had two horns.

source.text: וּרְאִיתִ֞יו מַגִּ֣יעַ׀אֵ֣צֶל הָאַ֗יִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־הָאַ֔יִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔יו וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּאַ֖יִל לַעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤הוּ אַ֨רְצָה֙ וַֽיִּרְמְסֵ֔הוּ וְלֹא־הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָאַ֖יִל מִיָּדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I saw it approaching beside the ram, and it was enraged against it, and it struck the ram, and it broke its two horns, and there was no strength in the ram to stand before it; and it threw it to the ground and trampled it, and there was none delivering the ram from its hand.

en.L: And I saw it come close to the ram, and it was enraged against it, and it struck the ram and broke its two horns; and there was no strength in the ram to stand before it. And it threw it to the ground and trampled it, and there was no one to rescue the ram from its hand.
en.B: I saw it reach the ram. It was furious with it, struck the ram and broke both its horns. The ram had no strength to stand against it. The goat threw it to the ground and trampled on it, and no one could rescue the ram from its power.
en.R: I saw it attack the ram. It was very angry with it. It hit the ram and broke off both of its horns. The ram was not strong enough to fight back. The goat knocked it to the ground and stamped on it. No one could save the ram from the goat's power.

fr.L: Et je le vis arriver près du bélier, et il s’irrita contre lui, et il frappa le bélier et brisa ses deux cornes ; et il n’y avait pas de force dans le bélier pour tenir devant lui. Et il le jeta à terre et le piétina, et il n’y avait personne pour délivrer le bélier de sa main.
fr.B: Je le vis atteindre le bélier. Furieux contre lui, il frappa le bélier et lui brisa les deux cornes. Le bélier n’avait pas la force de lui résister. Le bouc le jeta à terre et le piétina, et personne ne put arracher le bélier à son pouvoir.
fr.R: Je l’ai vu attaquer le bélier. Il était très en colère contre lui. Il a frappé le bélier et lui a cassé les deux cornes. Le bélier n’était pas assez fort pour se défendre. Le bouc l’a renversé par terre et l’a piétiné. Personne n’a pu sauver le bélier du pouvoir du bouc.

es.L: Y lo vi llegar junto al carnero, y se enfureció contra él, e hirió al carnero y le quebró sus dos cuernos; y no había fuerza en el carnero para estar en pie delante de él. Y lo derribó en tierra y lo pisoteó, y no hubo quien librara al carnero de su mano.
es.B: Vi que llegaba hasta el carnero. Estaba furioso con él, golpeó al carnero y le rompió los dos cuernos. El carnero no tenía fuerzas para hacerle frente. El macho cabrío lo derribó al suelo y lo pisoteó, y nadie pudo librar al carnero de su poder.
es.R: Vi que atacaba al carnero. Estaba muy enojado con él. Golpeó al carnero y le rompió los dos cuernos. El carnero no tenía fuerzas para defenderse. El macho cabrío lo tiró al suelo y lo pisoteó. Nadie pudo salvar al carnero del poder del macho cabrío.

sw.L: Nami nikamwona akimkaribia yule kondoo dume, naye akamkasirikia sana, akampiga kondoo dume, akazivunja pembe zake mbili; wala kondoo dume hakuwa na nguvu ya kusimama mbele yake. Naye akamtupa chini, akamkanyaga, wala hapakuwa na mtu wa kumwokoa kondoo dume kutoka mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Nilimwona akimfikia yule kondoo dume. Alimkasirikia sana, akampiga, akazivunja pembe zake zote mbili. Kondoo dume hakuwa na nguvu za kusimama dhidi yake. Beberu akamtupa chini na kumkanyaga, wala hakuna aliyeweza kumwokoa kondoo dume kutoka katika uwezo wake.
sw.R: Nilimwona akimshambulia yule kondoo dume. Alikuwa na hasira kali juu yake. Alimpiga kondoo dume na kuzivunja pembe zake zote mbili. Kondoo dume hakuwa na nguvu za kujitetea. Beberu akamwangusha chini na kumkanyagakanyaga. Hakuna aliyeweza kumwokoa kondoo dume kutoka katika nguvu za beberu.

vi.L: Và tôi thấy nó đến gần bên con chiên đực, và nó nổi giận với con chiên, và nó đánh con chiên đực và bẻ gãy hai sừng nó; và con chiên đực không có sức để đứng nổi trước nó. Và nó quật con chiên xuống đất và giày đạp nó, và không ai giải cứu con chiên đực khỏi tay nó.
vi.B: Tôi thấy nó xông đến con chiên đực. Nó giận dữ với con chiên, húc con chiên và bẻ gãy cả hai sừng. Con chiên đực không còn sức chống lại nó. Con dê quật con chiên xuống đất và giày đạp lên, và không ai giải cứu được con chiên khỏi quyền lực của nó.
vi.R: Tôi thấy nó tấn công con chiên đực. Nó rất giận con chiên. Nó húc con chiên và bẻ gãy cả hai sừng. Con chiên đực không đủ sức chống trả. Con dê quật con chiên xuống đất và giẫm đạp lên. Không ai cứu được con chiên khỏi quyền lực của con dê.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 보니, 그것이 숫양 곁에 다가가서 그것에게 격분하여 숫양을 치고 그 두 뿔을 꺾었다. 그리고 숫양에게는 그 앞에 설 힘이 없었다. 그리고 그것이 숫양을 땅에 내던지고 짓밟았는데, 숫양을 그 손에서 구해 낼 자가 없었다.
ko.B: 나는 그것이 숫양에게 다가가는 것을 보았다. 그것은 숫양에게 몹시 성이 나서 숫양을 쳐서 그 두 뿔을 꺾어 버렸다. 숫양에게는 그것을 당해 낼 힘이 없었다. 숫염소는 숫양을 땅에 내던지고 짓밟았다. 숫양을 그 힘에서 구해 낼 이가 아무도 없었다.
ko.R: 나는 그것이 숫양을 공격하는 것을 보았다. 그것은 숫양에게 몹시 화가 나 있었다. 그것은 숫양을 들이받아 두 뿔을 다 부러뜨렸다. 숫양은 맞서 싸울 힘이 없었다. 숫염소는 숫양을 땅에 쓰러뜨리고 짓밟았다. 아무도 숫양을 숫염소의 힘에서 구해 줄 수 없었다.

decisions.choice: the goat breaks the ram's two horns: the fall of the Persian empire
decisions.reason: In the usual reading this is Alexander's defeat of the Persian king Darius III in 333 and 331 BC, which ended the empire of the Medes and Persians. The horns are its two parts, Media and Persia (verse 20).

decisions.choice: from its hand: from its power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: from its power (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "from its hand"; Balanced and Readable give its sense.

source.text: וּצְפִ֥יר הָעִזִּ֖ים הִגְדִּ֣יל עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וּכְעָצְמ֗וֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ הַקֶּ֣רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֜נָה חָז֤וּת אַרְבַּע֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the he-goat of the goats magnified itself to excess; and as it became mighty, the horn the great was broken, and there came up conspicuousness four in its place toward [the] four winds of the heavens.

en.L: And the male goat became exceedingly great; but when it was strong, the great horn was broken, and in its place there came up four conspicuous [horns] toward the four winds of the heavens.
en.B: The male goat became very great, but at the height of its power the great horn was broken off. In its place four prominent horns came up, pointing toward the four winds of heaven.
en.R: The male goat became very powerful. But when it was at its strongest, its large horn was broken off. Four other large horns grew in its place. They pointed in all four directions.

fr.L: Et le bouc devint extrêmement grand ; et quand il fut puissant, la grande corne se brisa, et à sa place s’élevèrent quatre [cornes] remarquables, vers les quatre vents des cieux.
fr.B: Le bouc devint très grand, mais au sommet de sa puissance la grande corne se brisa. À sa place poussèrent quatre cornes bien visibles, tournées vers les quatre vents du ciel.
fr.R: Le bouc est devenu très puissant. Mais quand il était au plus fort de sa puissance, sa grande corne s’est cassée. Quatre autres grandes cornes ont poussé à sa place. Elles étaient tournées dans les quatre directions.

es.L: Y el macho cabrío se engrandeció en gran manera; pero cuando estaba fuerte, el gran cuerno fue quebrado, y en su lugar subieron cuatro [cuernos] notables hacia los cuatro vientos de los cielos.
es.B: El macho cabrío llegó a ser muy grande, pero en el apogeo de su poder se le rompió el gran cuerno. En su lugar salieron cuatro cuernos prominentes, que apuntaban hacia los cuatro vientos del cielo.
es.R: El macho cabrío se volvió muy poderoso. Pero cuando estaba en su mayor fuerza, se le rompió el cuerno grande. En su lugar le salieron otros cuatro cuernos grandes, que apuntaban en las cuatro direcciones.

sw.L: Na yule beberu akajikuza mno; lakini alipokuwa na nguvu, ile pembe kubwa ikavunjika, na mahali pake zikatokea [pembe] nne zilizo dhahiri, kuelekea pepo nne za mbinguni.
sw.B: Beberu akawa mkuu sana, lakini alipofikia kilele cha nguvu zake, ile pembe kubwa ilivunjika. Mahali pake ziliota pembe nne kubwa, zikielekea pepo nne za mbinguni.
sw.R: Beberu akawa na nguvu nyingi sana. Lakini alipokuwa na nguvu kuliko wakati wowote, pembe yake kubwa ilivunjika. Pembe nyingine nne kubwa ziliota mahali pake. Zilielekea pande zote nne za dunia.

vi.L: Và con dê đực trở nên cực kỳ lớn mạnh; nhưng khi nó đang hùng mạnh, thì cái sừng lớn bị gãy, và ở chỗ nó mọc lên bốn [cái sừng] dễ thấy, hướng về bốn ngọn gió của các tầng trời.
vi.B: Con dê đực trở nên rất lớn mạnh, nhưng khi nó đang ở đỉnh cao quyền lực thì cái sừng lớn bị gãy. Ở chỗ ấy mọc lên bốn cái sừng nổi bật, hướng về bốn ngọn gió của trời.
vi.R: Con dê đực trở nên rất hùng mạnh. Nhưng khi nó mạnh nhất thì cái sừng lớn của nó bị gãy. Bốn cái sừng lớn khác mọc lên thay chỗ ấy. Chúng chĩa ra bốn hướng.

ko.L: 그리고 그 숫염소가 매우 커졌는데, 그것이 강해졌을 때에 그 큰 뿔이 꺾였고, 그 대신에 눈에 띄는 [뿔] 넷이 하늘의 네 바람을 향하여 올라왔다.
ko.B: 그 숫염소는 매우 강대해졌다. 그러나 힘이 가장 셀 때에 그 큰 뿔이 꺾이고, 그 자리에 두드러진 뿔 넷이 하늘의 네 바람 쪽으로 돋아났다.
ko.R: 그 숫염소는 아주 강해졌다. 그러나 가장 힘이 셀 때에 그 큰 뿔이 부러졌다. 그 자리에 다른 큰 뿔 넷이 돋아났다. 그 뿔들은 동서남북 네 방향을 향하고 있었다.

decisions.choice: the great horn broken at the height of its strength: the first king's sudden end
decisions.reason: Verse 21 says the great horn is the first king of Greece. In the usual identification this is Alexander, who died in Babylon in 323 BC at about thirty-two, at the height of his power. His empire was divided among his generals, and in time it formed four main kingdoms, the four horns (verse 22).

decisions.choice: four conspicuous horns: the word for "horns" is not written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "four conspicuousness", using the noun from verse 5 ("a horn of conspicuousness"); the word "horns" is understood. Some ancient translations read "four other horns".

decisions.choice: toward the four winds of heaven: toward the four directions
decisions.reason: The four winds are the four points of the compass (7:2; 11:4). The empire is divided into parts that face every way.

decisions.choice: in all four directions (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "the four winds of heaven" (m3).

decisions.choice: "동서남북 네 방향" (R) for "the four winds of heaven"
decisions.reason: Readable gives the idiom's sense, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep "하늘의 네 바람".

source.text: וּמִן־הָאַחַ֣ת מֵהֶ֔ם יָצָ֥א קֶֽרֶן־אַחַ֖ת מִצְּעִירָ֑ה וַתִּגְדַּל־יֶ֛תֶר אֶל־הַנֶּ֥גֶב וְאֶל־הַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְאֶל־הַצֶּֽבִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And from the one of them came out a horn, one, from smallness, and it became great exceedingly toward the south and toward the east and toward the beauty.

en.L: And out of one of them came a horn, a small one, and it grew exceedingly great toward the south and toward the east and toward the beautiful [land].
en.B: Out of one of them came another horn, which started small but grew very great, toward the south and the east and toward the beautiful land.
en.R: Then a small horn came out of one of those horns. It grew very powerful, toward the south and the east and toward the beautiful land of Israel.

fr.L: Et de l’une d’elles sortit une corne, une [seule], petite, et elle grandit extrêmement vers le sud, et vers l’est, et vers la [terre] de beauté.
fr.B: De l’une d’elles sortit une autre corne, petite au début, qui grandit beaucoup vers le sud, vers l’est et vers le pays magnifique.
fr.R: Puis une petite corne est sortie de l’une de ces cornes. Elle est devenue très puissante, vers le sud, vers l’est et vers le beau pays d’Israël.

es.L: Y de uno de ellos salió un cuerno, uno pequeño, y creció en gran manera hacia el sur, y hacia el oriente, y hacia la [tierra] hermosa.
es.B: De uno de ellos salió otro cuerno, que comenzó pequeño pero creció mucho hacia el sur, hacia el oriente y hacia la tierra hermosa.
es.R: Luego, de uno de esos cuernos salió un cuerno pequeño. Se hizo muy poderoso hacia el sur, hacia el este y hacia la hermosa tierra de Israel.

sw.L: Na kutoka katika moja yao ikatokea pembe moja, ndogo, nayo ikakua sana kuelekea kusini na kuelekea mashariki na kuelekea [nchi] nzuri.
sw.B: Kutoka katika moja ya pembe hizo ikatokea pembe nyingine, iliyoanza ikiwa ndogo, lakini ikakua sana kuelekea kusini na mashariki na kuelekea nchi nzuri.
sw.R: Kisha pembe ndogo ilitokea katika mojawapo ya pembe zile. Ilipata nguvu nyingi sana kuelekea kusini na mashariki na kuelekea nchi nzuri ya Israeli.

vi.L: Và từ một trong số chúng mọc ra một cái sừng, [một cái] nhỏ, và nó lớn lên rất nhiều về phía nam, về phía đông, và về phía [xứ] tuyệt đẹp.
vi.B: Từ một trong các sừng ấy mọc ra một cái sừng khác, lúc đầu nhỏ, nhưng lớn lên rất nhiều về phía nam, về phía đông và về phía xứ tuyệt đẹp.
vi.R: Rồi một cái sừng nhỏ mọc ra từ một trong các sừng ấy. Nó trở nên rất mạnh, vươn về phía nam, phía đông và về phía xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên xinh đẹp.

ko.L: 그리고 그것들 가운데 하나에서 작은 뿔 하나가 나왔는데, 그것이 남쪽과 동쪽과 아름다운 [땅] 쪽으로 매우 커졌다.
ko.B: 그것들 가운데 하나에서 또 다른 뿔 하나가 나왔다. 그 뿔은 작게 시작했으나 남쪽과 동쪽과 아름다운 땅 쪽으로 매우 커졌다.
ko.R: 그때 그 뿔들 가운데 하나에서 작은 뿔 하나가 나왔다. 그 뿔은 남쪽과 동쪽으로, 그리고 이스라엘의 아름다운 땅 쪽으로 뻗어 나가며 아주 강해졌다.

decisions.choice: a small horn from one of the four: a later king of one of the four kingdoms
decisions.reason: Verse 23 explains it as a king who arises at the end of their rule. It is usually identified as Antiochus IV Epiphanes, king of the Seleucid kingdom of Syria from 175 to 164 BC, who campaigned in Egypt (the south) and in the east, and who persecuted the Jews in Judea. The text gives no name. Christian readers have also seen in him a pattern of a final opponent of God.

decisions.choice: the beauty: the beautiful land, the land of Israel
decisions.reason: The word means beauty or glory. Jeremiah 3:19 and Ezekiel 20:6, 15 call the land God gave Israel the most beautiful of all lands. Daniel uses the same word for it in 11:16 and 11:41, and for the holy mountain in 11:45.

decisions.choice: the small horn: compare the small horn of 7:8
decisions.reason: Both visions have a small horn that grows proud and attacks God's people and his worship. The horn of chapter 7 comes from the fourth beast, and this one from the goat, so readers who take the fourth beast as Rome see two different figures; readers who take it as Greece see the same king in both.

decisions.choice: the beautiful [land] (L); the beautiful land (B); the beautiful land of Israel (R)
decisions.reason: Literal brackets "land"; Balanced supplies it; Readable names the land (m2).

decisions.choice: "la [terre] de beauté" (L), "le pays magnifique" (B), "le beau pays d'Israël" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "the beauty"; Literal brackets the noun French needs, Balanced names the land, Readable names Israel, as the English does at each level.

decisions.choice: "아름다운 [땅]" (L); "아름다운 땅" (B); "이스라엘의 아름다운 땅" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for "the beautiful land", kept the same through chapters 8 and 11; Readable names the land as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "la [tierra] hermosa" (L); "la tierra hermosa" (B); "la hermosa tierra de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording wherever Daniel names the land by its beauty (11:16, 41)

source.text: וַתִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתַּפֵּ֥ל אַ֛רְצָה מִן־הַצָּבָ֥א וּמִן־הַכּוֹכָבִ֖ים וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it became great up to the host of the heavens, and it made fall to the ground [some] from the host and from the stars, and it trampled them.

en.L: And it grew great, up to the host of the heavens, and it made some of the host and of the stars fall to the ground, and trampled them.
en.B: It grew until it reached the host of heaven, and it threw some of the host and some of the stars down to the earth and trampled on them.
en.R: It grew so tall that it reached the army of heaven, the stars. It threw some of them down to the ground and stamped on them.

fr.L: Et elle grandit jusqu’à l’armée des cieux, et elle fit tomber à terre [une partie] de l’armée et des étoiles, et elle les piétina.
fr.B: Elle grandit jusqu’à atteindre l’armée du ciel, et elle fit tomber à terre une partie de cette armée et des étoiles, et les piétina.
fr.R: Elle a grandi au point d’atteindre l’armée du ciel, c’est-à-dire les étoiles. Elle en a fait tomber quelques-unes par terre et les a piétinées.

es.L: Y se engrandeció hasta el ejército de los cielos, e hizo caer a tierra [parte] del ejército y de las estrellas, y los pisoteó.
es.B: Creció hasta alcanzar el ejército del cielo, y echó por tierra a parte del ejército y de las estrellas, y los pisoteó.
es.R: Creció tanto que llegó hasta el ejército del cielo, es decir, las estrellas. Tiró algunas de ellas al suelo y las pisoteó.

sw.L: Nayo ikakua mpaka jeshi la mbinguni, ikaangusha chini baadhi ya jeshi na ya nyota, ikazikanyaga.
sw.B: Ilikua mpaka ikalifikia jeshi la mbinguni, ikaangusha chini duniani baadhi ya jeshi hilo na baadhi ya nyota, ikazikanyaga.
sw.R: Ilikua ndefu sana hata ikalifikia jeshi la mbinguni, yaani nyota. Iliangusha chini baadhi yake, ikazikanyagakanyaga.

vi.L: Và nó lớn lên đến tận đạo binh của các tầng trời, và nó làm cho [một số] trong đạo binh và trong các ngôi sao rơi xuống đất, và giày đạp chúng.
vi.B: Nó lớn lên cho đến khi chạm tới đạo binh trên trời, và nó quăng một số trong đạo binh ấy và một số ngôi sao xuống đất rồi giày đạp chúng.
vi.R: Nó cao lớn đến nỗi chạm tới đạo binh trên trời, tức là các ngôi sao. Nó ném một số ngôi sao xuống đất rồi giẫm đạp lên.

ko.L: 그리고 그것이 하늘들의 군대에까지 커져서, 그 군대와 별들 가운데 일부를 땅에 떨어뜨리고 그것들을 짓밟았다.
ko.B: 그것은 하늘의 군대에 닿을 만큼 커져서, 그 군대 가운데 일부와 별들 가운데 일부를 땅으로 떨어뜨리고 짓밟았다.
ko.R: 그것은 하늘의 군대, 곧 별들에 닿을 만큼 높이 자랐다. 그리고 그 별들 가운데 몇을 땅에 떨어뜨리고 짓밟았다.

decisions.choice: the host of heaven, the stars: heavenly beings, standing also for God's people
decisions.reason: "The host of heaven" means the stars, often pictured as an army, and the heavenly beings around God (1 Kings 22:19; Isaiah 24:21). The horn's attack on the stars is an attack on heaven itself. Since God's people are compared to the stars (Genesis 15:5; Daniel 12:3), and the horn destroys "the people of the holy ones" (verse 24), the picture is usually read as his persecution of the faithful, seen as an assault on God's own host.

decisions.choice: it grew great up to the host of heaven: pride that reaches for heaven
decisions.reason: Isaiah 14:13-14 pictures the king of Babylon saying, "I will ascend to heaven; above the stars of God I will set my throne." Revelation 12:4 has the dragon sweep a third of the stars to the earth.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens (L); the host of heaven (B); the army of heaven, the stars (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "host", the older word for an army that is used of the stars and of heavenly beings. Readable says "army" and adds "the stars" from the same verse.

decisions.choice: "l'armée des cieux" (L), "l'armée du ciel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: French "armée" carries the sense of the Hebrew "host" plainly, so one noun serves at every level; the plural "cieux" at Literal follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "jeshi la mbinguni" for the host of heaven
decisions.reason: The published phrase for the host of heaven (2 Kings 17:16; 21:3), in the singular as the Hebrew has it. Readable adds "yaani nyota" as the English Readable adds "the stars".

decisions.choice: "đạo binh của các tầng trời" (L); "đạo binh trên trời" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Đạo binh trên trời" is the published wording for the heavenly host in 1 Kings 22:19 and 2 Chronicles 18:18; "cơ binh" is kept in Kings for the stars as objects of worship. Readable adds "tức là các ngôi sao", as the English Readable names the stars.

decisions.choice: "el ejército de los cielos" (L); "el ejército del cielo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The published wording for the host of heaven (Deuteronomy 4:19; 1 Kings 22:19)

source.text: וְעַ֥ד שַֽׂר־הַצָּבָ֖א הִגְדִּ֑יל וּמִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ הוּרַ֣ם הַתָּמִ֔יד וְהֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And up to the commander of the host it magnified itself, and from him was removed the regular [offering], and was thrown down the place of his sanctuary.

en.L: And it magnified itself even up to the Prince of the host; and from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the regular [offering] was taken away, and the place of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary was thrown down.
en.B: It even set itself up against the Prince of the host. It took away the regular offering from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and the place of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary was overthrown.
en.R: It even made itself as great as the Prince of heaven's army. It took away the daily sacrifices offered to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and the place where {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple stood was torn down.

fr.L: Et jusqu’au Prince de l’armée elle s’éleva ; et [le sacrifice] continuel {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} fut enlevé, et le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire fut renversé.
fr.B: Elle s’éleva même contre le Prince de l’armée. Elle {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} enleva le sacrifice régulier, et le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire fut renversé.
fr.R: Elle s’est même faite aussi grande que le Prince de l’armée du ciel. Elle a supprimé les sacrifices qu’on {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} offrait chaque jour, et l’endroit où se trouvait {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint temple a été démoli.

es.L: Y hasta el Príncipe del ejército se engrandeció; y de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fue quitado el [sacrificio] continuo, y el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario fue derribado.
es.B: Incluso se alzó contra el Príncipe del ejército, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} quitó el sacrificio continuo, y el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario fue derribado.
es.R: Incluso se creyó tan grande como el Príncipe del ejército del cielo. Suprimió los sacrificios diarios que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ofrecían, y el lugar donde estaba {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo templo fue destruido.

sw.L: Na hata juu ya Mkuu wa jeshi ilijikuza; na kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} [sadaka ya] kila siku ikaondolewa, na mahali pa patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} pakatupwa chini.
sw.B: Ilijiinua hata dhidi ya Mkuu wa jeshi. Iliiondoa sadaka ya kila siku iliyotolewa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, na mahali pa patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} pakaangushwa.
sw.R: Ilijifanya kuwa kubwa kama Mkuu wa jeshi la mbinguni. Ilizikomesha dhabihu za kila siku zilizotolewa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, na mahali hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu liliposimama pakabomolewa.

vi.L: Và nó tự tôn mình lên cho đến tận Đấng Thống Lãnh của đạo binh; và từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, [của lễ] thường xuyên bị cất đi, và nơi đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bị phá đổ.
vi.B: Nó còn tự tôn mình lên chống lại Đấng Thống Lãnh đạo binh. Nó cất bỏ của lễ thường xuyên dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và nơi đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bị lật đổ.
vi.R: Nó còn tự cho mình lớn ngang với Đấng Thống Lãnh đạo binh trên trời. Nó chấm dứt các tế lễ hằng ngày dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và nơi đền thờ thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bị phá đổ.

ko.L: 그리고 그것이 그 군대의 군주께까지 스스로를 높였다. 그리고 그분에게서 늘 드리는 [제사]가 없어졌고, 그분의 성소가 있는 곳이 무너졌다.
ko.B: 그것은 하늘 군대의 군주이신 분께까지 맞서며 스스로를 높였다. 그것은 그분께 늘 드리던 제사를 없애 버렸고, 그분의 성소가 있던 곳은 무너졌다.
ko.R: 그것은 자기가 하늘 군대를 다스리시는 군주만큼 크다고 높였다. 그것은 그분께 날마다 드리던 제사를 멈추게 했다. 그리고 그분의 거룩한 성전이 서 있던 곳은 허물어졌다.

decisions.choice: the Prince of the host: God himself, the commander of heaven's army
alternatives: Michael, the angelic prince of 10:21 and 12:1
decisions.reason: The word means a commander or ruler. The host has just been named as heaven's army (verse 10), and the sanctuary and the regular offering belong to this Prince, so he is God. Verse 25 calls him "the Prince of princes". Some readers take him to be the archangel Michael, called "the great prince" (12:1; compare Joshua 5:14, "the commander of the LORD's army"), or the high priest, but the sanctuary is "his".

decisions.choice: the regular offering was taken away
decisions.reason: The regular offering is the burnt offering made every morning and evening at the temple (Exodus 29:38-42). In the usual reading this describes Antiochus IV's stopping the temple sacrifices in Jerusalem in 167 BC (1 Maccabees 1:44-50); see 11:31.

decisions.choice: it magnified itself ... was taken away ... was thrown down: a change of verb forms
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves between "it" (a masculine form, as if the king himself were meant) and passive verbs. The text in verses 11-12 is hard and has been read in more than one way, but the sense is clear: the horn exalts itself against God, stops his worship and ruins his sanctuary.

decisions.choice: the Prince of the host, capitalized; him, his (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: The table for Daniel gives "prince" for the angels called princes (10:13, 20-21; 12:1). Here the Prince is God (m1), so every level capitalizes the title and the pronouns for him take the deity_pronoun setting. Readable says "the Prince of heaven's army".

decisions.choice: the regular [offering] (L); the regular offering (B); the daily sacrifices (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "the continual", the name for the offering made every morning and evening (Exodus 29:38-42; Numbers 28:3-8). Literal brackets "offering"; Readable says "daily sacrifices".

decisions.choice: "[le sacrifice] continuel" (L), "le sacrifice régulier" (B), "les sacrifices qu'on lui offrait chaque jour" (R), for chapters 8-12
decisions.reason: As the French of Exodus 29:42 and Numbers 28:3 renders the same word for the daily burnt offering: "continuel" at Literal, "régulier" at Balanced; Readable says "every day", as the English Readable "the daily sacrifices".

decisions.choice: "le Prince de l'armée", capitalised, with deity_pronoun spans on "lui" and "son"
decisions.reason: The English takes the Prince as God and capitalises him; French does the same, with the object pronoun "lui" under the span where English has "him".

decisions.choice: "Mkuu wa jeshi", capitalized, with deity_pronoun spans only on the free forms "kwake", "pake", "lake"
decisions.reason: The Prince of the host is God, as the English capitalizes. Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the Swahili has spans only where a free pronoun or possessive stands; this holds for Daniel 8-12.

decisions.choice: "[sadaka ya] kila siku" (L); "sadaka ya kila siku" (B); "dhabihu za kila siku" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "the continual"; Literal brackets the supplied "sadaka ya". "Ya kila siku" ties it to the daily burnt offering of Numbers 28:3-6 ("sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku"). Used the same way in 8:12-13; 11:31; 12:11.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Thống Lãnh của đạo binh", capitalised, with "Ngài" spans
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the Prince of the host as God himself. "Đấng" marks a divine person, and "Thống Lãnh" keeps him apart from "thủ lĩnh", the term sheet's word for the angelic princes (sar) of chapters 10-12. Joshua 5:14's "tướng chỉ huy đạo quân" is a different figure. The same title returns in verse 25.

decisions.choice: "[của lễ] thường xuyên" (L); "của lễ thường xuyên" (B); "các tế lễ hằng ngày" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "the regular" (tamid), the word of Exodus 29:42 ("của lễ thiêu thường xuyên"). Literal brackets the noun; Readable says what it was, the daily sacrifices. The same wording holds through 8:12-13, 11:31 and 12:11.

decisions.choice: "그 군대의 군주께" (L); "하늘 군대의 군주이신 분께" (B); "하늘 군대를 다스리시는 군주" (R), with 께, -시- and 그분
decisions.reason: The Prince of the host is God, so he takes the honorific where the English has deity pronouns; Korean has no deity_pronoun spans and carries the respect with 께, -시- and 그분. "군주" keeps the link with the angelic princes of 10:13-21 and the "Prince of princes" of 8:25.

decisions.choice: "늘 드리는 [제사]" (L); "늘 드리던 제사" (B); "날마다 드리던 제사" (R) for the tamid
decisions.reason: Exodus 29:42 and Numbers 28:3 call it "늘 드리는 번제"; Daniel has the bare word "regular", so Literal brackets the supplied noun, and the same wording holds in 8:12-13, 11:31 and 12:11.

decisions.choice: "el Príncipe del ejército", capitalized, with deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The Prince is God, as the English reads him, so the title is capitalized and his pronouns take deity_pronoun spans; "ejército" as in verse 10

decisions.choice: "el [sacrificio] continuo" (L); "el sacrificio continuo" (B); "los sacrificios diarios" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the regular offering (8:11–13; 11:31; 12:11). "Continuo" is the word of the published "holocausto continuo"; R says what it was, as the English R does

source.text: וְצָבָ֛א תִּנָּתֵ֥ן עַל־הַתָּמִ֖יד בְּפָ֑שַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And a host will be given over together with the regular [offering] in transgression, and it will throw truth to the ground, and it will act and succeed.

en.L: And a host will be given over, together with the regular [offering], because of transgression; and it will throw truth to the ground, and it will act and prosper.
en.B: Because of rebellion, the host will be handed over to it, together with the regular offering. It will throw truth to the ground, and it will succeed in all it does.
en.R: Because of people's sin, God's people and the daily sacrifices will be handed over to the horn. It will throw truth down to the ground. It will succeed in everything it does.

fr.L: Et une armée sera livrée avec le [sacrifice] continuel à cause de la transgression ; et elle jettera la vérité à terre, et elle agira et réussira.
fr.B: À cause de la rébellion, l’armée lui sera livrée, avec le sacrifice régulier. Elle jettera la vérité à terre, et elle réussira dans tout ce qu’elle fera.
fr.R: À cause du péché des gens, le peuple de Dieu et les sacrifices de chaque jour seront livrés à la corne. Elle jettera la vérité par terre. Elle réussira dans tout ce qu’elle fera.

es.L: Y un ejército será entregado, junto con el [sacrificio] continuo, a causa de la transgresión; y echará por tierra la verdad, y actuará y prosperará.
es.B: A causa de la rebelión, el ejército le será entregado junto con el sacrificio continuo. Echará por tierra la verdad y tendrá éxito en todo lo que haga.
es.R: Por causa del pecado de la gente, el pueblo de Dios y los sacrificios diarios serán entregados al cuerno. Echará por tierra la verdad. Tendrá éxito en todo lo que haga.

sw.L: Na jeshi litatolewa pamoja na [sadaka ya] kila siku kwa sababu ya maasi; nayo itaitupa kweli chini, nayo itatenda na kufanikiwa.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya makosa, jeshi litatiwa mikononi mwake pamoja na sadaka ya kila siku. Itaitupa kweli chini, nayo itafanikiwa katika kila inalofanya.
sw.R: Kwa sababu ya dhambi za watu, watu wa Mungu watatiwa mikononi mwa pembe hiyo pamoja na dhabihu za kila siku. Pembe hiyo itaitupa kweli chini. Itafanikiwa katika kila jambo inalofanya.

vi.L: Và một đạo binh sẽ bị phó [cho nó] cùng với [của lễ] thường xuyên, vì sự vi phạm; và nó sẽ quăng chân lý xuống đất, và nó sẽ hành động và thành công.
vi.B: Vì sự phản nghịch, đạo binh sẽ bị phó cho nó cùng với của lễ thường xuyên. Nó sẽ quăng chân lý xuống đất, và nó làm việc gì cũng thành công.
vi.R: Vì dân chúng phạm tội, dân của Đức Chúa Trời và các tế lễ hằng ngày sẽ bị giao vào tay cái sừng ấy. Nó sẽ ném chân lý xuống đất. Nó làm gì cũng thành công.

ko.L: 그리고 반역 때문에 군대가 늘 드리는 [제사]와 함께 넘겨질 것이고, 그것이 진리를 땅에 내던질 것이며, 그것이 행하고 형통할 것이다.
ko.B: 반역 때문에 군대가 늘 드리는 제사와 함께 그 뿔에게 넘겨질 것이다. 그 뿔은 진리를 땅에 내던질 것이며, 하는 일마다 잘될 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들의 죄 때문에 하나님의 백성과 날마다 드리는 제사가 그 뿔에게 넘겨질 것이다. 그 뿔은 진리를 땅바닥에 내던질 것이다. 그리고 하는 일마다 성공할 것이다.

decisions.choice: a host will be given over, with the regular offering, because of transgression: a hard sentence
alternatives: an army will be set over the regular offering with transgression
the host will be given over in place of the regular offering, through transgression
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is one of the hardest in the book. "Host" has no article and may mean the host of verse 10, God's people, or an army that the horn sets over the offering. "Transgression" may be the sin of God's people for which they are handed over, or the horn's own rebellion, which is set up in place of the offering (compare "the transgression that makes desolate", verse 13). The ancient translations differ here. The reading taken here, that God's people and their worship are handed over because of transgression, is one of several.

decisions.choice: truth: the true teaching and worship of God
decisions.reason: "Truth" here is God's truth as it is known in his law and worship. Throwing it to the ground pictures the suppression of the law under persecution (1 Maccabees 1:56-57).

decisions.choice: people's sin; God's people (R)
decisions.reason: Readable takes the reading given in m1 and says whose sin and which host it means. This is one reading of a hard verse, so it is marked uncertain.

decisions.choice: the regular [offering] (L); the regular offering (B); the daily sacrifices (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "the continual", the name for the offering made every morning and evening (Exodus 29:38-42; Numbers 28:3-8). Literal brackets "offering"; Readable says "daily sacrifices".

decisions.choice: "la transgression" (L), "la rébellion" (B), "le péché" (R) for pesha' in chapters 8-12
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives "crime", "rébellion" at Balanced; "rébellion" fits a revolt against God's worship, as the English Balanced "rebellion". Readable says "péché".

decisions.choice: "maasi" (L); "makosa" (B); "dhambi" (R) for pesha'
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for pesha', as Psalm 51:3, used for the noun throughout these chapters; the participle "transgressors" is "waasi" (L, B).

decisions.choice: "반역" (L, B); "죄" (R) for pesha'
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for pesha' in these books; Readable uses the plain word.

decisions.choice: "transgresión" (L); "rebelión" (B); "pecado" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives "delito" at B for peshaʿ, but in Daniel the word names a revolt against God and his worship, and "el delito que trae la ruina" (8:13) would not read naturally; B says "rebelión", the noun of the sheet's verb "rebelarse", as the English B says "rebellion"

source.text: וָאֶשְׁמְעָ֥ה אֶֽחָד־קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד־מָתַ֞י הֶחָז֤וֹן הַתָּמִיד֙ וְהַפֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְקֹ֥דֶשׁ וְצָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And I heard one holy [one] speaking, and one holy [one] said to the certain [one] who was speaking: Until when [is] the vision, the regular [offering] and the transgression desolating, to give both sanctuary and host [as] a trampling place?

en.L: And I heard one holy one speaking; and one holy one said to the one who was speaking, "For how long is the vision, the regular [offering], and the transgression that makes desolate, the giving over of both the sanctuary and the host to be trampled?"
en.B: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and a second holy one asked the one who spoke, "How long will the vision last: the regular offering taken away, the rebellion that brings ruin, and the sanctuary and the host given over to be trampled?"
en.R: Then I heard one of God's holy angels speaking. Another holy angel asked him, "How long will the things in this vision go on? How long will the daily sacrifices be stopped? How long will the sin that brings ruin go on? How long will the temple and God's people be stamped on?"

fr.L: Et j’entendis un saint qui parlait ; et un saint dit à celui qui parlait : « Jusqu’à quand [durera] la vision, le [sacrifice] continuel, et la transgression qui dévaste, pour livrer le sanctuaire et l’armée à être piétinés ? »
fr.B: Puis j’entendis un saint qui parlait, et un autre saint demanda à celui qui parlait : « Combien de temps durera la vision : le sacrifice régulier supprimé, la rébellion qui apporte la ruine, le sanctuaire et l’armée livrés pour être piétinés ? »
fr.R: Ensuite, j’ai entendu un des saints anges de Dieu qui parlait. Un autre saint ange lui a demandé : « Combien de temps vont durer les choses de cette vision ? Combien de temps les sacrifices de chaque jour seront-ils arrêtés ? Combien de temps va durer le péché qui apporte la ruine ? Combien de temps le temple et le peuple de Dieu seront-ils piétinés ? »

es.L: Y oí a un santo que hablaba; y otro santo dijo a aquel que hablaba: «¿Hasta cuándo [durará] la visión: el [sacrificio] continuo, y la transgresión que causa desolación, y la entrega tanto del santuario como del ejército para ser pisoteados?».
es.B: Entonces oí a un santo que hablaba, y otro santo le preguntó al que hablaba: «¿Cuánto tiempo durará la visión: el sacrificio continuo suprimido, la rebelión que trae la ruina, y el santuario y el ejército entregados para ser pisoteados?».
es.R: Entonces oí hablar a uno de los santos ángeles de Dios. Otro santo ángel le preguntó: «¿Cuánto tiempo durará lo que se ve en esta visión? ¿Hasta cuándo estarán suspendidos los sacrificios diarios? ¿Hasta cuándo seguirá el pecado que trae la ruina? ¿Hasta cuándo serán pisoteados el templo y el pueblo de Dios?».

sw.L: Nami nikamsikia mtakatifu mmoja akisema, na mtakatifu mmoja akamwambia yule fulani aliyekuwa akisema, "Maono [haya ni] mpaka lini: [sadaka ya] kila siku, na maasi yaletayo ukiwa, kutolewa kwa patakatifu na jeshi viwe kitu cha kukanyagwa?"
sw.B: Kisha nikamsikia mtakatifu mmoja akisema, na mtakatifu mwingine akamwuliza yule aliyekuwa akisema, "Maono haya yatadumu mpaka lini: sadaka ya kila siku kuondolewa, makosa yanayoleta maangamizi, na patakatifu na jeshi kutolewa ili vikanyagwe?"
sw.R: Kisha nikamsikia malaika mmoja mtakatifu wa Mungu akisema. Malaika mwingine mtakatifu akamwuliza, "Mambo yaliyo katika maono haya yataendelea mpaka lini? Dhabihu za kila siku zitakomeshwa mpaka lini? Dhambi inayoleta maangamizi itaendelea mpaka lini? Hekalu na watu wa Mungu watakanyagwa mpaka lini?"

vi.L: Và tôi nghe một đấng thánh đang nói, và một đấng thánh [khác] nói với đấng đang nói kia: "Khải tượng về [của lễ] thường xuyên, và sự vi phạm gây hoang tàn, việc phó cả đền thánh lẫn đạo binh cho bị giày đạp, sẽ kéo dài cho đến bao giờ?"
vi.B: Rồi tôi nghe một đấng thánh đang nói, và một đấng thánh khác hỏi đấng đang nói: "Khải tượng này sẽ kéo dài bao lâu: của lễ thường xuyên bị cất bỏ, sự phản nghịch gây ra cảnh hoang tàn, đền thánh và đạo binh bị phó cho kẻ thù giày đạp?"
vi.R: Rồi tôi nghe một thiên sứ thánh của Đức Chúa Trời đang nói. Một thiên sứ thánh khác hỏi thiên sứ ấy: "Những việc trong khải tượng này sẽ kéo dài bao lâu? Các tế lễ hằng ngày sẽ bị ngưng lại bao lâu? Tội lỗi gây ra sự tàn phá sẽ còn bao lâu? Đền thờ và dân của Đức Chúa Trời sẽ bị giẫm đạp đến bao giờ?"

ko.L: 그리고 내가 한 거룩한 이가 말하는 것을 들었다. 그리고 한 거룩한 이가 말하고 있던 그 어떤 이에게 말했다. "그 환상, 곧 늘 드리는 [제사]와 황폐하게 하는 반역, 성소와 군대를 내주어 짓밟히게 하는 일이 언제까지이냐?"
ko.B: 그때 나는 한 거룩한 이가 말하는 것을 들었다. 그리고 또 다른 거룩한 이가 말하던 그 이에게 물었다. "이 환상, 곧 늘 드리는 제사가 없어지고, 멸망을 가져오는 반역이 일어나고, 성소와 군대가 짓밟히도록 내주어지는 일이 언제까지 계속되겠느냐?"
ko.R: 그때 나는 하나님의 거룩한 천사 하나가 말하는 것을 들었다. 또 다른 거룩한 천사가 그에게 물었다. "이 환상에서 본 일이 언제까지 계속되겠느냐? 날마다 드리는 제사가 언제까지 멈춰 있겠느냐? 멸망을 가져오는 죄가 언제까지 계속되겠느냐? 성전과 하나님의 백성이 언제까지 짓밟히겠느냐?"

decisions.choice: a holy one: an angel
decisions.reason: As in 4:10, 14, 20, the holy ones here are heavenly beings, who speak to one another about the vision.

decisions.choice: the one who was speaking: a word meaning "a certain one"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses a rare word meaning "so-and-so", "a certain one", for the first speaker, whom it does not name.

decisions.choice: the transgression that makes desolate: the outrage that ruins the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The phrase is close to "the abomination that makes desolate" (9:27; 11:31; 12:11), using "transgression" or "rebellion" in place of "abomination". The verb means to make desolate or to appall. It is the act or object by which the horn defiles the sanctuary and leaves it empty of true worship.

decisions.choice: rebellion (B); sin (R)
decisions.reason: The noun follows the wording set for the verb from the same root: "transgress", "rebel" and "sin" at the three levels. "That brings ruin" follows the Balanced and Readable wording of "the abomination that makes desolate".

decisions.choice: the regular [offering] (L); the regular offering (B); the daily sacrifices (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "the continual", the name for the offering made every morning and evening (Exodus 29:38-42; Numbers 28:3-8). Literal brackets "offering"; Readable says "daily sacrifices".

decisions.choice: God's holy angels; several questions (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says that the holy ones are angels (m1) and breaks the long question into four short ones.

decisions.choice: "un saint" (L, B), "un des saints anges de Dieu" (R)
decisions.reason: "Un saint" is the plain French for the Hebrew "a holy one"; the meaning decision explains that it is an angel, and Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "mtakatifu mmoja" (L, B) for "a holy one"; Readable says "malaika mtakatifu"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "holy one"; Literal and Balanced keep it, and Readable names the angel, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "một đấng thánh" (L, B); "một thiên sứ thánh" (R)
decisions.reason: "Đấng" is the respectful word for a heavenly being, as the term sheet's "một đấng canh giữ, một đấng thánh" (4:10); "vị thánh" would suggest a human saint. Readable names the angels, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "거룩한 이" (L, B); "하나님의 거룩한 천사" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for "a holy one" in Daniel (4:10; 8:13); Readable names the angel, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: The holy ones speak to each other in 해라체 ("언제까지 계속되겠느냐?")
decisions.reason: Angels take no honorific in Daniel; one asking another is speech between equals, which the Korean style guide puts in 해라체.

decisions.choice: "un santo" (L, B); "santos ángeles" (R)
decisions.reason: A holy one is an angel; L and B keep the noun "santo" as the Hebrew does, R names the angels as the English R does

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י עַ֚ד עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וְנִצְדַּ֖ק קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me: Until evening morning two thousand and three hundreds, and [the] sanctuary will be put right.

en.L: And he said to me, "Until 2,300 evenings [and] mornings; then the sanctuary will be put right."
en.B: He said to me, "For 2,300 evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be restored to its proper state."
en.R: He said to me, "It will go on for 2,300 evenings and mornings. Then the temple will be made pure again."

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Jusqu’à 2 300 soirs [et] matins ; et le sanctuaire sera rétabli dans son droit. »
fr.B: Il me dit : « Pendant 2 300 soirs et matins. Ensuite le sanctuaire sera rétabli dans son état. »
fr.R: Il m’a dit : « Cela durera 2 300 soirs et matins. Ensuite, le temple sera de nouveau purifié. »

es.L: Y me dijo: «Hasta 2 300 tardes [y] mañanas; entonces el santuario será restablecido».
es.B: Me respondió: «Durante 2 300 tardes y mañanas. Después el santuario será restaurado como debe ser».
es.R: Me dijo: «Esto durará 2 300 tardes y mañanas. Después el templo volverá a ser purificado».

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Mpaka jioni [na] asubuhi 2,300; ndipo patakatifu patarekebishwa."
sw.B: Akaniambia, "Kwa muda wa jioni na asubuhi 2,300. Kisha patakatifu patarudishwa katika hali yake inayofaa."
sw.R: Akaniambia, "Itaendelea kwa jioni na asubuhi 2,300. Kisha hekalu litatakaswa tena."

vi.L: Và người nói với tôi: "Cho đến 2.300 buổi chiều [và] buổi sáng; rồi đền thánh sẽ được phục hồi."
vi.B: Người nói với tôi: "Trong 2.300 buổi chiều và buổi sáng. Sau đó đền thánh sẽ được khôi phục đúng như phải có."
vi.R: Người nói với tôi: "Việc ấy sẽ kéo dài 2.300 buổi chiều và buổi sáng. Sau đó đền thờ sẽ được tẩy sạch trở lại."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 나에게 말했다. "2,300 저녁 [그리고] 아침까지이다. 그러면 성소가 바로잡힐 것이다."
ko.B: 그가 나에게 말했다. "2,300 저녁과 아침 동안이다. 그 뒤에 성소가 제 모습을 되찾을 것이다."
ko.R: 그가 나에게 말했다. "그 일은 2,300 저녁과 아침 동안 계속될 것이다. 그 뒤에 성전이 다시 깨끗하게 될 것이다."

decisions.choice: 2,300 evenings and mornings: either 2,300 days or 1,150 days
decisions.reason: "Evening morning" may mean a full day, as in Genesis 1 ("there was evening and there was morning"), giving 2,300 days, a little over six years. Or it may count the evening and morning offerings that were stopped (verse 13), so that 2,300 offerings make 1,150 days, a little over three years. The second fits the time of about three years between the stopping of the sacrifices in 167 BC and the cleansing of the temple in 164 BC (1 Maccabees 1:54; 4:52-53), in the usual reading. The text does not settle it.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary will be put right: restored, cleansed, vindicated
decisions.reason: The verb is from the word for righteousness and means "be put right" or "be vindicated". The sanctuary will be restored to its proper state and worship. Some ancient translations say "cleansed". In the usual reading this is the rededication of the temple by Judas Maccabeus in December 164 BC, remembered in the festival of Hanukkah (1 Maccabees 4:36-59; John 10:22).

decisions.choice: 2,300 in figures (all levels)
decisions.reason: The style guide writes numbers above ninety-nine in figures, at every level.

decisions.choice: made pure again (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "put right" for a sanctuary that has been defiled (m2).

decisions.choice: "2 300" in figures, with a no-break space, at every level
decisions.reason: The English writes the figure at every level so that the reader can compare 12:11-12; French does the same, following its own typography for thousands.

decisions.choice: "2.300" in figures, with a thousands dot
decisions.reason: The term sheet writes numbers from 100 in figures; Vietnamese marks thousands with a dot.

decisions.choice: "2,300 저녁과 아침" in figures at every level
decisions.reason: Large numbers are in figures, as the term sheet sets; the pair "저녁과 아침" is kept so that the reading as 2,300 days or 1,150 days stays open, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "2 300" in figures, with a space
decisions.reason: As the English writes the number in figures; Spanish writes numbers of four digits and more with a space

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּרְאֹתִ֛י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת־הֶחָז֑וֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁ֣ה בִינָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְנֶגְדִּ֖י כְּמַרְאֵה־גָֽבֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when I saw, I, Daniel, the vision, and I sought understanding, and look, standing before me [one] like the appearance of a man.

en.L: And it happened, when I, Daniel, saw the vision and sought understanding, that, look, standing before me was one with the appearance of a man.
en.B: As I, Daniel, watched the vision and tried to make sense of it, someone who looked like a man suddenly stood in front of me.
en.R: I, Daniel, saw the vision and tried to understand it. Then suddenly someone who looked like a man was standing in front of me.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand moi, Daniel, je vis la vision et que je cherchai à comprendre, que voici, se tenait devant moi [quelqu’un] qui avait l’apparence d’un homme.
fr.B: Pendant que moi, Daniel, je regardais la vision et cherchais à la comprendre, quelqu’un qui ressemblait à un homme se tint soudain devant moi.
fr.R: Moi, Daniel, j’ai vu la vision et j’ai essayé de la comprendre. Alors, tout à coup, quelqu’un qui ressemblait à un homme s’est trouvé debout devant moi.

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras yo, Daniel, veía la visión y buscaba entendimiento, he aquí que estaba de pie delante de mí uno con apariencia de hombre.
es.B: Mientras yo, Daniel, observaba la visión y trataba de comprenderla, de repente se puso delante de mí alguien que parecía un hombre.
es.R: Yo, Daniel, vi la visión y traté de entenderla. Entonces, de pronto, alguien que parecía un hombre estaba de pie delante de mí.

sw.L: Ikawa, mimi Danieli nilipoyaona maono hayo, nikatafuta ufahamu, na tazama, amesimama mbele yangu mmoja mwenye sura ya mwanamume.
sw.B: Mimi Danieli nilipokuwa nikiyatazama maono hayo na kujaribu kuyaelewa, ghafla mtu aliyeonekana kama mwanamume alisimama mbele yangu.
sw.R: Mimi Danieli niliyaona maono hayo, nikajaribu kuyaelewa. Ghafla mtu aliyeonekana kama mwanamume alikuwa amesimama mbele yangu.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi tôi, Đa-ni-ên, thấy khải tượng và tìm cách hiểu, thì kìa, đứng trước mặt tôi có [một vị] có hình dạng như một người nam.
vi.B: Đang khi tôi, Đa-ni-ên, xem khải tượng và cố tìm hiểu ý nghĩa, thình lình có một vị trông giống như người nam đứng trước mặt tôi.
vi.R: Tôi, Đa-ni-ên, thấy khải tượng ấy và cố gắng hiểu nó. Bỗng nhiên có một vị trông giống như một người đàn ông đứng trước mặt tôi.

ko.L: 그리고 나 다니엘이 그 환상을 보고 깨달음을 구하고 있을 때에, 보라, 사람의 모습 같은 이가 내 앞에 서 있었다.
ko.B: 나 다니엘이 그 환상을 보면서 그 뜻을 알려고 애쓰고 있을 때에, 갑자기 사람처럼 보이는 이가 내 앞에 섰다.
ko.R: 나 다니엘은 그 환상을 보고 그 뜻을 깨달으려고 애썼다. 그때 갑자기 사람처럼 보이는 이가 내 앞에 서 있었다.

decisions.choice: one with the appearance of a man: a heavenly being in human form
decisions.reason: The word for "man" here is the one for a strong man, and the name "Gabriel" in the next verse is formed from the same root, meaning "God is my strong one" or "man of God". The being who stands before Daniel looks like a man but is an angel, as the next verse shows.

decisions.choice: someone who looked like a man (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Man" is kept here, since the word is the one for a strong man and the being is called Gabriel; it does not mean a human being in general.

decisions.choice: "사람의 모습 같은 이" (L); "사람처럼 보이는 이" (B, R), with "이" and no honorific
